news.title: Gauthier scores 2nd straight hat trick in Ducks’ 5-4 win over Canucks
news.ruTitle: Готье оформил второй хет-трик подряд в победе «Дакс» над «Кэнакс» со счетом 5:4.
news.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored a hat trick for the second game in a row and the Anaheim Ducks held on for a 5-4 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Tuesday night.

news.title: Which NHL coaches have the most wins in history?
news.ruTitle: Какие тренеры НХЛ одержали больше всего побед в истории?
news.description: Scotty Bowman leads all NHL coaches in wins all-time. Find out who else makes the list.

news.title: Saros makes 29 saves to lead Predators over Hurricanes 4-1
news.ruTitle: Сарос сделал 29 сейвов и обыграл «Харрикейнз» «Хищников» со счетом 4–1.
news.description: — Roman Josi and Ross Colton each had a goal and an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 4-1 victory over the Carolina Hurricanes on Tuesday night.

news.title: Jets beat Canadiens in OT with latest 4-goal comeback in NHL history
news.ruTitle: Джетс обыграли Канадиенс в овертайме и забили 4 гола в истории НХЛ
news.description: Dylan Samberg scored in overtime as the Winnipeg Jets snapped a nine-game losing streak by storming back from a four-goal deficit to beat the Montreal Canadiens 5-4 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Samberg lifts Jets past Canadiens 5-4 with OT goal to complete comeback from 4-goal deficit
news.ruTitle: Самберг обыграл «Джетс» «Канадиенс» со счетом 5:4, забив гол в овертайме и завершив возвращение после дефицита в 4 гола
news.description: — Dylan Samberg scored in overtime as the Winnipeg Jets snapped a nine-game losing streak by storming back from a four-goal deficit to beat the Montreal Canadiens 5-4 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Back on home ice after trade request, Kucherov has two assists in Lightning win
news.ruTitle: Вернувшись на домашний лед после запроса на обмен, Кучеров сделал две результативные передачи в победе «Лайтнинг»
news.description: In Tampa Bay's 4-2 win over the Red Wings on Tuesday, NHL MVP Nikita Kucherov had two assists in his first home game since asking the Lightning for a trade, and he was greeted warmly, with fans holding a "We stand with Kuch 86" sign during warmups.

news.title: Jack Hughes scores 2 goals as Devils beat Oilers in Connor Hellebuyck's first home start
news.ruTitle: Джек Хьюз забивает 2 гола, когда «Девилз» обыграли «Ойлерз» в первом домашнем матче Коннора Хеллебака
news.description: — Jack Hughes scored two goals and had an assist, Connor Hellebuyck made 19 saves to win his first home start of the season and the New Jersey Devils ended the Edmonton Oilers' winning streak at three by winning 4-3 in a shootout on Tuesday night.

news.title: Tomas Hertl's 2nd goal of the game with 32 seconds remaining lifts Vegas by Pittsburgh 3-2
news.ruTitle: Второй гол Томаса Хертля в игре за 32 секунды до конца матча принес победу "Вегасу" над "Питтсбургом" со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Tomas Hertl's second goal of the night with 32 seconds left in regulation lifted the Vegas Golden Knights past the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Adam Fox sparks Rangers to a 3-1 win over the Blues, snapping 4-game skid
news.ruTitle: Адам Фокс привел «Рейнджерс» к победе над «Блюзом» со счетом 3:1, преодолев 4-матчевый занос
news.description: — Adam Fox had a goal and an assist, Dylan Garand made 32 saves, and the New York Rangers snapped a four-game losing streak with a 3-1 win over the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday night.

news.title: Wild beat Flyers 4-2 after referee deflection leads to game-winning goal
news.ruTitle: Уайлд обыграл Флайерз со счетом 4:2 после отклонения арбитра и привел к победному голу
news.description: — Matt Boldy had a goal and an assist, and Joel Eriksson Ek scored what proved to be the winner after a Flyers clearing attempt hit a referee as the Minnesota Wild beat the Philadelphia Flyers 4-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Schmaltz scores on the power play late in regulation to lift Mammoth past Maple Leafs 3-2
news.ruTitle: Шмальц забивает гол в игре в большинстве в конце основного матча и выводит Мамонта из игры "Мэйпл Лифс" со счетом 3-2.
news.description: — Nick Schmaltz scored the winner on a power play with 6:48 left in regulation and the Utah Mammoth beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Robertson's natural hat trick paces Stars to 6-5 win over Caps
news.ruTitle: Естественный хет-трик Робертсона позволил "Старз" одержать победу над "Кэпс" со счетом 6:5.
news.description: — Jason Robertson scored the third-fastest natural hat trick in team history to help the Dallas Stars to a 6-5 victory over the Washington Capitals on Tuesday night.
